title: Linear Turán Numbers of Uniform Hypertrees
summary: A hypergraph is linear if every pair of vertices is contained in at most one hyperedge. We study linear Turán numbers of acyclic $r$-uniform hypergraphs, extending earlier work of Gyárfás, Ruszinkó, and Sárközy from uniformity $3$ to general $r$, with emphasis on hypertrees with four hyperedges. For the linear path $P_4^r$, we prove $\operatorname{ex}^{\mathrm{lin}}_r(n,P_4^r)\le (r+1)n/r$, with equality precisely for disjoint unions of Steiner systems $S(2,r,r^2)$, whenever such systems exist. We also give counterexamples to a structural claim used in a previously proposed proof for $r=4$.…
